$comment: Card skeletons and lane slices (README 'Skeletons and lanes'). Patterns are case-insensitive JavaScript regexes. A story can suit several lanes; it is written once and listed in each lane's slice.

made.$comment: A story suits 'made' when a link in it counts as built, it is in Built this week, or a member's post in it has a video, or has a picture or text matching a pattern here. Makers are the members whose posts carry that evidence.

talk.$comment: A conversation or running bit: at least minPosts posts from at least minMembers members, or a spiked phrase.

games.$comment: Stories with a game account's posts, a winning post, or words about scores, records and bets.

voices.$comment: Members the show has never featured. Each unmarked post scores ln(1 + engagement) + 1.2 x lift over the author's usual - audienceWeight x log10(followers + 10); a voice is the sum of its three best. Bots, accounts over maxFollowers, and posts inside stories the consent rules leave out are not listed.

interview.$comment: Ranked by having made something in the window and been asked about it in public: usable question-and-answer pairs whose question replies to, quotes or sits under the post that shows the made thing; then by how many such pairs, from how many different people, about how many made things. All of a candidate's usable pairs are given. minPairs applies to candidates with none about a made thing.

tagged.$comment: What the audience pointed at (README 'The tagged lane'). A post that tags the show's account (a mention facet with its DID) is a pointer when it points at something that is not the show: the post it replies to or quotes, a link, or its own top-level post with a picture, video, link or at least minOwnWords words besides mentions. aboutShowPatterns (case-insensitive regexes on the tag's own text and alt text) mark a tag that only talks about the show; it stays with the posts about the show (reviewers only). Only members of this window's cluster count as taggers; bots and excluded accounts never do. Each counted pointer weighs the tagger's membership score (cluster.json expansion.weights and caps) divided by the window's highest member score, at least weight.floor; a member's nth distinct thing in the window counts weight.repeatDecay^(n-1), the same thing twice counts once, and at most perTaggerCap count. search: searchPosts for mentions of the show's DID on host (each query a string q or searchPosts parameters; `mentions:` in q answers 400 unauthenticated, the mentions parameter is used instead) (cluster.json's note: it answers unauthenticated on api.bsky.app), each query at most maxPages pages; {did} and {handle} are filled in. A pointed-at thread not in the digest is fetched with one getPostThread each, at most maxThreads per run, threadDepth deep, and written as a skeleton marked outsideCluster.

queries.$comment: the mentions parameter, by DID; the q operators (mentions:, from:) answer 400 unauthenticated
the handle as text, for an AppView that refuses the parameter; every hit is checked for a mention facet with the DID

bots.$comment: An account is a bot when it carries the self-label 'bot', is a configured game account, is listed here (DIDs), or its profile description matches a pattern here.
